description: FREE (no API key needed). Use when the user asks to find or list businesses by name, keyword, sector or city (e.g. 'dentists in Madrid', 'real estate agencies in Valencia'). Search businesses by name, keyword, country, city or sector. Results mix registry-backed companies and public business listings (local directories/maps), so not every result is registry-verified; use entity_lookup or verify_vat to verify one. Answers 'find me a dentist in Madrid' / 'list law firms in Barcelona'. `sector` is a closed vocabulary — see the enum; aliases such as `abogados` resolve to their canonical slug. Anonymous callers receive a trace-level preview (name + city); authenticated TRACE+ keys unlock full records.

city.description: City name (Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Sevilla, London)

sector.description: Sector filter. Canonical: dental, legal, estetica, psicologia, medicos, talleres, veterinarios, reformas, inmobiliarias, asesorias, gimnasios… Aliases (abogados, salud, dentist, beautysalon…) resolve to a canonical slug and the response declares the translation in _meta.sector_resolved_from.
